Class Edge

java.lang.Object
Edge
public class Edge extends Object
Represents a directed road edge (segment) between two junctions.

An edge is a one-way road segment containing multiple lanes. Key features:

  • Directional: Each physical road typically has two edges (one per direction)
  • Contains 1+ lanes positioned perpendicular to the edge centerline
  • Clipped at junction boundaries to avoid visual overlaps
  • Rendered with proper lane markings (center line and dividers)

Rendering includes:

  • Road surface as a thick line
  • Yellow center line (drawn only for positive edge IDs to avoid duplication)
  • White dashed lane dividers between lanes
  • Proper clipping at source and destination junctions

    • Edge

      public Edge(NetworkParser.Edge networkEdge, NetworkParser.Junction from, NetworkParser.Junction to, Junction fromJunc, Junction toJunc)
      Constructs a new visual Edge from parsed network data. Automatically creates visual Lane objects for each lane in the network edge.
      Parameters:
      networkEdge - The parsed edge data from SUMO network file
      from - The source junction network data
      to - The destination junction network data
      fromJunc - The visual source junction object
      toJunc - The visual destination junction object

    • render

      public void render(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext g, CoordinateTransform transform)
      Renders the edge including road surface and lane markings.

      The rendering process:

      1. Calculates junction-clipped endpoints
      2. Draws road surface as a thick line
      3. Draws yellow center line (one direction only)
      4. Draws white dashed lane dividers
      Parameters:
      g - The graphics context to draw on
      transform - The coordinate transformation
